stackDivergence.rationale: Original bounded UTF16 character/view/const-reference indexOf and lastIndexOf preserve logical lengths, offsets, embedded zero and isolated surrogate units; empty needles return -1 and default forward/reverse offsets are 0/current length. The std::basic_string_view backend is adapted to native JS indexOf/lastIndexOf through exact UTF16 unit views, without normalization. Actual newFromSubString/copy reuse the existing shared allocator/assign owners: full spans acquire the original data, other spans retain original replacement/self-field lifetimes and complete live buffers. Genuine full SAL/OUString dependencies with347 full pinned sources produce8532312 complete bytes, including all65536 character values and25 complete substring input vectors; normal and ASan/UBSan streams agree. Eleven genuine checked C assertions map to Error, preserving their expressions. Invalid copy ranges are undefined in the public contract; the original NDEBUG diagnostic fallback is not certified. Native ABI/concurrency, physical pointer lifetime, ASCII literal search overloads, other string APIs and complete upstream QA remain unverified. Type-name parsing/getByName and UNO/case-service consumers remain incomplete.
